fractionation method: The selected protein spots were manually excised from gels stained with Coomassie Brilliant Blue G250 (Merck) and identified by Liquid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS/MS)
instrument: LC-MS/MS analyses were performed using Exploris 240 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific), coupled to an EASY-nLC 1200 system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
reduction reagent: The washed pellet was subsequently treated with SDS extraction buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1 M EDTA, 2% SDS, 10 mM DTT) for 10 min at 100 °C and centrifuged.
